space_moon_helium_mine_desc: Extrae helio-3 de la superficie lunar
space_red_info_desc: El planeta rojo %0 orbita alrededor del sol a una distancia de aproximadamente 1.4 UA
space_red_mission_effect: Lanzar una misión para examinar el planeta rojo %0.
space_red_mission_action: %0 no ofrece muchos recursos raros, pero sus científicos lo consideran la mejor perspectiva para una colonia fuera del mundo
space_terraformer_effect: Slowly transforms the atmosphere to be more hospitable to your species.
space_terraformer_effect2: Power this facility to begin transforming your planet.
space_terraform_effect: Terraform this planet into one of your own design. It might even be more suitable for another evolution.
space_red_living_quarters_desc: Proporciona espacio vital para los colonos
space_red_factory_effect1: Las fábricas se pueden usar para producir cualquier cantidad de productos manufacturados. Utiliza 3MW por fábrica.
space_red_asphodel_desc: Cultiva flores de asfódelos para atraer almas mediocres
space_red_biodome_flair: Todo lo que se necesitó fue cultivar una papa
space_red_biodome_flair_carn: Delicioso ganado pastando en un 38% de gravedad
space_red_asphodel_flair: Para las almas que nunca llegarán al paraíso
space_red_exotic_lab_flair2: la pared aquí para ver qué se pega
space_red_ziggurat_desc: Zigurat dedicado a una raza antigua de %0
space_hell_info_desc: El planeta %0 se encuentra a aproximadamente 0,4 UA del sol y hace mucho calor
space_hell_mission_effect1: Lanzar una misión para estudiar el planeta infernal %0.
space_hell_mission_action: %0 es un planeta caliente cerca del Sol. Sus perspectivas de desarrollo son malas
space_hell_swarm_plant_desc: Planta de producción de satélite enjambre
space_hell_swarm_plant_effect1: Reduce el costo de los satélites enjambre en %0%.
space_sun_info_desc: La estrella en el corazón del sistema %0
space_sun_mission_effect1: Lanzar una misión para estudiar el sol.
space_sun_salvage_ship_desc: The derelict hulk of the %0 drifts near the sun. Salvage it and tow it back to your shipyard.
space_sun_salvage_ship_effect: Recover a derelict ship, adding it to your fleet parked at the shipyard. Your techs will analyze the ship logs for information about the state of the solar system.
space_hell_salvage_ship_desc: The crashed hulk of the %0 sits abandoned on the surface of %1. Salvage it and tow it back to your shipyard.
space_hell_salvage_ship_effect: Recover a derelict ship, adding it to your fleet parked at the shipyard.
space_sun_swarm_control_effect1: Controla hasta %0 satélites de enjambre y transmite su poder a la civilización.
space_gas_info_desc: El planeta %0 es un gigante gaseoso ubicado a aproximadamente 5,2 UA del sol. Es el planeta más grande del sistema %1
space_gas_mission_effect: Lanzar una misión para estudiar el gigante gaseoso %0.
space_gas_mission_action: %0 es verdaderamente masivo, su atmósfera es rica en helio-3.
space_gas_storage_desc: Depósito orbital utilizado para almacenar combustibles
space_gas_star_dock_wiki: Space Station orbiting the gas giant used to construct ships to explore the galaxy.
space_gas_moon_info_desc: %0 es la luna más grande en órbita alrededor del gigante gaseoso %1.
space_gas_moon_mission_action: Se descubrió un material superdenso compuesto completamente de neutrones en %0.
space_gas_moon_outpost_desc: Puesto avanzado de minería de neutronio
space_gas_moon_drone_effect1: Aumenta la producción de puestos avanzados de minería en un %0%.
space_belt_info_desc: El cinturón de asteroides se encuentra entre %0 y %1, es una fuente de recursos potencialmente rica.
space_belt_info_desc2: Debe asignar mineros espaciales para aumentar el apoyo en el cinturón de asteroides
space_belt_mission_desc: Lanzar una encuesta del Cinturón de Asteroides.
space_belt_mission_effect1: Lanzar una misión para estudiar el cinturón de asteroides en busca de posibles oportunidades mineras.
space_belt_mission_action: El cinturón de asteroides es extremadamente peligroso pero contiene una inmensa riqueza mineral
space_belt_station_desc: Estación de minería de espacio profundo.
space_belt_iron_ship_effect3: Reduce los costos de planta de enjambre.
space_dwarf_info_desc: %0 es un planeta enano ubicado a unos 2.8AU del Sol. Es el único planeta enano conocido en el sistema solar interno.
space_dwarf_mission_action: %0 parece ser una roca sin vida con pocos recursos de valor, es el lugar perfecto para almacenar materiales peligrosos
space_dwarf_collider_effect1: Construye un segmento de 1 milla del supercolisionador mundial.
space_dwarf_collider_flair: ¿Qué es lo peor que podría pasar?
space_dwarf_mass_relay_effect: Construct part of the Mass Relay
space_dwarf_mass_relay_effect2: Triples speed of ships leaving from %0
space_titan_info_desc: The moon %0 is the largest moon orbiting the 2nd gas giant in the %1 system. It averages around 9.54AU from the sun and has a dense planet-like atmosphere.
space_titan_mission_effect: Launch a mission to study the moon %0.
space_titan_mission_action: %0 is the most %1-like planetoid you've discovered so far. Although challenging due to the cold temperatures and lack of liquid water, it would be possible to set up a permanent colony here.
space_metalworks_effect: +%0% total metal production per %1 colonist, divided as below
space_enceladus_info_desc: The moon %0 is the 6th-largest moon orbiting the 2nd gas giant in the %1 system. Geyser jets continuously eject water into space from the moon's surface.
space_enceladus_mission_action: A massive subterranean ocean of liquid water exists on %0. This could be an important source of water for your colonies.
space_triton_info_desc: %0 is the largest moon orbiting the farthest planet in the %1 system. It has a retrograde orbit and an icy surface made mostly of frozen nitrogen.
space_triton_mission_effect: Launch a mission to investigate the signal coming from the moon %0.
space_triton_mission_action: A massive crashed spaceship of unknown origin has been found on %0. Syndicate spies have learned of your discovery and are preparing an expedition force of their own to steal it. You must secure this important relic.
space_fob_msg: Syndicate forces have landed ground troops; you must wage war both in space and on the ground.
space_kuiper_desc: The Kuiper Belt is a vast area surrounding the solar system made up of asteroids and other stellar objects. It is comprised of everything in the region of space from about 30AU to 50AU from the sun.
space_kuiper_mission_effect: Launch a mission to scout areas of interest in the Kuiper Belt identified from the derelict ship data.
space_kuiper_mission_action: Several mineral rich sites have been identified in the Kuiper Belt; however, Syndicate ships were also detected scouting the area.
space_eris_info_desc: %0 is a dwarf planet located 68AU from the sun. It is the 9th-largest known object by mass to orbit the sun.
space_eris_mission_effect: Launch a mission to scout the dwarf planet %0.
space_eris_mission_action: %0 is a frozen wasteland on the outer edge of the solar system. A spectrographic analysis indicates nothing valuable enough to warrant further expeditions this far out; however, your probe detected a Syndicate buildup here. Perhaps you should dispatch ships to find out what they have discovered.
space_eris_scan: The Syndicate activity is organized mostly around a dig site on %0. They seem to be excavating some kind of alien outpost.
interstellar_alpha_desc1: Alpha Centauri es un sistema estelar binario cercano ubicado a 4.36 años luz de %0. Sospechamos que varios planetas pueden estar orbitando alrededor de él
interstellar_alpha_desc2: Alpha Centauri es un sistema estelar binario cercano ubicado a 4.36 años luz de %0. El cuarto planeta, designado Alpha Centauri IV, es candidato para una base extrasolar permanente
interstellar_alpha_mission_effect: Enviar una nave al sistema Alpha Centauri para inspeccionarla.
interstellar_alpha_mission_result: Alpha Centauri IV parece ser un gran candidato para una colonia.
interstellar_mining_droid_effect: Los droides mineros pueden encargarse de extraer materiales valiosos del suelo. Se pueden configurar para extraer Adamantita, uranio, carbón o aluminio.
interstellar_processing_effect: Aumenta el rendimiento del droide Adamantita en %0%.
interstellar_g_factory_effect: Convierte fuentes de carbono en grafeno.
interstellar_int_factory_effect: Manufacture new materials from old materials. Each Mega Factory has two production lines.
interstellar_proxima_desc1: Proxima Centauri es una enana roja ubicada a unos 0,12 años luz del sistema Alpha Centauri
interstellar_proxima_desc2: Proxima Centauri es una enana roja ubicada a unos 0,12 años luz del sistema Alpha Centauri. Un planeta rocoso solitario orbita el sistema
interstellar_proxima_mission_effect: Enviar una nave al sistema Proxima Centauri para determinar si tiene algún valor.
interstellar_proxima_mission_result: Un planeta rocoso solitario de poco valor orbita alrededor del sistema Proxima. Sin embargo, la posición estratégica de Proxima lo convierte en un gran lugar para una base de operaciones interestelar.
interstellar_xfer_station_desc: Una estación espacial profunda utilizada como centro de la región.
interstellar_cargo_yard_effect: Aumenta el almacenamiento del almacén en %0%.
interstellar_dyson_effect: Construir el 1% de la red Dyson.
interstellar_nebula_desc1: La Nebulosa Helix está bastante lejos a 694 años luz, pero esta podría ser una fuente muy rica de helio-3 para alimentar su expansión
interstellar_nebula_desc2: La Nebulosa Helix está bastante lejos a 694 años luz, es rica en valioso helio-3
interstellar_nebula_mission_effect: Enviar un barco a la Nebulosa Helix para evaluarlo para posibles operaciones de extracción de gas.
interstellar_nebula_mission_result: La Nebulosa Helix es rica en helio-3 como se esperaba. También contiene Deuterio y se han detectado depósitos de Elerium.
interstellar_nexus_desc: Una estación espacial profunda utilizada como centro de la región.
interstellar_neutron_desc1: Se ha detectado una estrella de neutrones aproximadamente a 619 años luz de distancia
interstellar_neutron_desc2: La estrella de neutrones, Calvera, está aproximadamente a 619 años luz de %0
interstellar_neutron_mission_effect: Embárcate en una misión peligrosa para estudiar la estrella de neutrones, Calvera.
interstellar_neutron_mission_result: Las emisiones peligrosas de rayos X hacen que la estrella de neutrones Calvera sea extremadamente peligrosa de abordar, sólo las naves blindadas deben acercarse a ella.
interstellar_citadel_desc: Estación central de inteligencia artificial avanzada
interstellar_citadel_effect2: Aumenta la producción de cemento en %0%
interstellar_stellar_forge_flair: The power of the sun in the palm of your hand
interstellar_blackhole_desc1: Se ha detectado un pequeño agujero negro a 487 años luz de %0
interstellar_blackhole_desc2: El agujero negro se encuentra a 487 años luz de %0. Es pequeño en cuanto a agujeros negros, con una masa de solo 8 masas solares
interstellar_blackhole_desc3: El agujero negro se encuentra a 487 años luz de %0. Tiene una masa de %1 masas solares
interstellar_blackhole_desc4: El agujero negro se encuentra a 487 años luz de %0. Tiene una masa de %1 de masas solares, con materia exótica que representa %2 de masa solar
interstellar_blackhole_desc5: El agujero negro podría valer %0 %3,%1 Fago y %2 Energía Oscura si de alguna manera explotara ...
interstellar_blackhole_mission_effect: Exploremos el agujero negro... por la ciencia!
interstellar_blackhole_mission_result: El agujero negro tiene una masa relativamente baja, aunque sigue siendo muy peligroso. Esto hace que sea más fácil de estudiar.
interstellar_blackhole_unstable: El agujero negro está comenzando a emitir lecturas extrañas, esto podría deberse a la contaminación de materia exótica.
interstellar_stellar_engine_effect2: La masa del agujero negro es %0 masas solares
interstellar_stellar_engine_effect3: La masa del agujero negro es %0 masas solares, con materia exótica que constituye %1 masa/s solar/es
interstellar_mass_ejector_effect: Expulsar masa en el agujero negro para agrandarlo, -%0MW.
interstellar_mass_ejector_flair: Esta es una buena idea, está bien
interstellar_mass_ejector_msg: Una nueva pestaña está disponible en "recursos".
interstellar_jump_ship_effect: Construct a special ship designed to navigate a natural wormhole. This ship must be heavily shielded and requires a unique drive capable of jumping into and out of an unstable wormhole.
interstellar_wormhole_mission_effect: Send the specially-designed jump ship into the unstable wormhole and see what's on the other side.
interstellar_wormhole_mission_result: You have successfully jumped the wormhole; an analysis of the stars places the destination as somewhere in the Andromeda galaxy!
interstellar_stargate_effect: Using the jumpship to transverse the natural wormhole, we can construct matching stargates which will allow stable travel to the faraway Andromeda galaxy without needing specially-designed ships that can withstand jumping a singularity.
interstellar_sirius_desc: Sirius is a binary star system 8.6 light years from the %0 system. Sirius A is a type M star, while Sirius B is a White Dwarf.
interstellar_sirius_b_desc: Sirius B is a white dwarf star, which means fusion has stopped and it has cooled enough for the surface to solidify, but it will continue to radiate great amounts of heat for trillions of years.
interstellar_sirius_mission_effect: Sirius is a system that was previously of low interest to the %0 Empire, but the ascension project has caused interest in studying a White Dwarf star and its close proximity to the %1 system makes it an ideal candidate.
interstellar_sirius_b_effect: Analyze Sirius B to unlock its secrets.
interstellar_space_elevator_effect: Sirius B's gravity is too strong to simply land ships on it; we need to construct a space elevator to access the surface.
interstellar_gravity_dome_effect: Sirius B's gravity is 350,000x stronger than %0. A special dome that can withstand the extreme pressure is required to house the project.
interstellar_ascension_machine_effect: The "Ascension Machine" is a device that can elevate your people to a new plane of existence. Constructing and activating this device is the ultimate goal for the %0 race.
interstellar_ascension_trigger_effect: The Ascension Machine; turning on this device will elevate your people to a new plane of existence.
interstellar_thermal_collector_effect: Reduces the power requirement of the Ascension Machine by -%0MW.
galaxy_piracy_msg: The %0 pirates have taken notice of your operations. You must increase security in each sector to counter the threat.
galaxy_stargate_desc: The region around the stargate is mostly empty space. There is a nearby star system 0.4 light years away, but not much else in the vicinity.
galaxy_stargate_desc_alt: The stargate is a critical transit point for your empire; security in this area will affect all production in Andromeda.
galaxy_gateway_station_desc: Gateway Station is a first stop foothold in the new galaxy.
galaxy_telemetry_beacon_effect1: +%0 Max Knowledge for each active Telemetry Beacon.
galaxy_gateway_desc: The Gateway system is the closest destination from the stargate at 0.4 light years. Logistically, this makes it a good staging ground for your expansion.
galaxy_gateway_mission_effect: Send a ship to the Gateway System to scout it for use as your base of operations in the Andromeda galaxy.
galaxy_encounter: One of your scout ships encountered an unknown alien vessel; your ship was destroyed after a failed attempt to communicate with the aliens.
galaxy_gorddon_desc: The Gorddon system is 14 light years from the stargate and seems to be a hotbed for alien activity. The system was named in honor of Captain Gorddon, who died during the first contact disaster.
galaxy_gorddon_mission_effect: A high amount of alien activity has been detected in the Gorddon System; it's possible a colony exists there. Attempt to make second contact with this species.
galaxy_gorddon_mission_result: You have established contact with a species of %0 that calls themselves %1. The first contact incident seems to have been the work of a hostile rival species of %2 called %3, but your relationship remains tenuous.
galaxy_embassy_complete: You have established relations with the %0 race. You can now negotiate trade routes with them by constructing freighters. The %0 warn you that %1 piracy is a big concern in the region; you'll need to protect your interests by building up your armada.
galaxy_symposium_effect2: +%0 Max Knowledge per active Galactic Trade Route
galaxy_symposium_effect3: +%0 Max Knowledge per crew stationed in system
galaxy_symposium_effect3b: Up to +%0 Max Knowledge per crew stationed outside system
galaxy_freighter_assign: Assign a freighter to import %0 and export %1.
galaxy_freighter_unassign: Unassign a freighter from importing %0 and exporting %1.
galaxy_alien1_desc: The %0 System is the home system of the %1. It is a binary star system 4.2 light years from the Gorddon System.
galaxy_consulate_desc: The Consulate is your local diplomatic office in the %0 system.
galaxy_vitreloy_plant_desc: Requires Power, Bolognium, Stanene, and Money.
galaxy_alien2_desc: The %0 System is a type G star system with heavy %1 activity in it. This system is rich with resources and the %1 do not take kindly to anyone else approaching it.
galaxy_alien2_mission_effect: Station the required invasion force at the %0 system then initiate the attack.
galaxy_alien2_mission_result2: You have successfully broken the %0 blockade, establishing a foothold in the system.
galaxy_scavenger_find: Your scavengers have recovered an alien database. You should research the alien data.
galaxy_chthonian_desc: The Chthonian system is named such because it contains the only known Chthonian planet ever detected by you. Strange readings emanate from the planet; however, the system is also fiercely guarded by the %0.
galaxy_chthonian_mission_result: You have weakened the enemy forces enough to allow entry into the system.
galaxy_chthonian_mission_result_losses: The following ships were lost during the battle: %0.
portal_first_gem: Sus soldados descubrieron una piedra peculiar después de una batalla. A todos los que se acercan a él les incomoda y casi parecen estar vivos
portal_corrupt_gem: The Soul Forge has produced an unusual Soul Gem; anyone who touches it is overcome by fits of rage and temporary insanity.
portal_fortress_desc: Una gran fortaleza construida en la dimensión Infierno para proteger el portal.
portal_carport_desc: Cada cochera agrega un vehículo de apoyo para 1 topógrafo. Los vehículos dañados deben repararse antes de que puedan ser ocupados por un topógrafo.
portal_war_droid_effect: Cada droide reforzará una unidad de patrulla, los droides en exceso defenderán la fortaleza.
portal_repair_droid_flair: I am bender, please insert girder
portal_badlands_desc: Las tierras baldías parecen continuar infinitamente en todas las direcciones. Aquí no hay nada más que páramos desolados y hordas interminables de demonios.
portal_war_drone_effect: Los drones pilotados de forma remota brindan apoyo aéreo a sus patrullas y ayudan a reducir la población demoníaca.
portal_attractor_desc: Estas balizas arcanas atraen demonios, aumentando la actividad demoníaca en el área.
portal_attractor_effect2: Aumenta la tasa de caída de %0.
portal_hell_pit_found: Your hell patrols have found a giant crater that is swarming with unusually high levels of demonic activity.
portal_pit_desc: The "pit" is a giant crater that is swarming with demonic activity. The endless hordes seem to be drawn to this location more than others.
portal_pit_mission_effect: Something is attracting demons to this area. Undertake a mission to find out.
portal_pit_mission_result: There appears to be some kind of ruins in the center of the pit. You will have to secure the ruins to study it further.
portal_assault_forge_effect: Mount an assault force to secure the pit and establish defensive fortifications.
portal_assault_forge_result: Upon securing the ruins, you discover a sophisticated artifact. Further research is required.
portal_soul_forge_desc: Captures the souls of defeated demons
portal_soul_forge_effect: Fuses the souls of defeated demons into a %0.
portal_soul_forge_warlord: Fuses the souls of those who have failed you into a %0.
portal_gun_emplacement_desc: Reduces soldier requirement of Soul Forge
portal_soul_attractor_effect: Attracts %0-%1 roaming souls into your Soul Forge per day.
portal_soul_attractor_effect2: Decreases souls required by Soul Forge by %0%.
portal_soul_capacitor_desc: Stores spirit energy harvested by the Soul Forge.
portal_absorption_chamber_effect: Activate to absorb the spirit energy and ascend. Requires %0 Spirit Energy.
portal_absorption_chamber_effect_eld: Activate to summon an Eldritch Horror. Requires %0 Spirit Energy.
portal_absorption_chamber_incomplete: Absorb the spirit energy for the purpose of ascension.
portal_ruins_desc: The ruins of an ancient city lay here. Crumbling remains of structures lay everywhere and twisted creatures roam the ruins. This place looks to have been abandoned eons ago.
portal_ruins_mission_result: You have found several interesting sites in the ruins worth exploring. Most of the large demon hordes seem to avoid the city for unknown reasons, but some dangerous creatures still roam the ruins.
portal_ruins_vault: Your archaeologists have discovered a chamber with an ornate closed vault.
portal_vault_effect: An ancient sealed vault. There is an altar in front of it with %0 sockets that look like they fit Soul Gems.
portal_vault_effect2: The Soul Gems triggered the door mechanism, but it jammed. You'll have to repair the door mechanism to open it.
portal_vault_result: Inside the vault you find an ancient tome called the Codex Infernium. You must study this tome to unlock its secrets.
portal_war_vault_effect: An ancient vault. There is an altar in front of it with %0 %1 embedded in it. The door is open, an empty pedestal is in the vault; it looks like someone already looted it.
portal_war_vault_effect2: An ancient sealed vault. The door is broken and will probably never open again.
portal_war_vault_result: You place the Codex Infernium in the vault and shut the door, the mechanism seems to break when you close it. You also pry out all the %0 from the altar.
portal_war_vault_fail: The %0 won't come free from the altar while the door is open, and the door won't shut until a suitable replacement object is left on the pedestal.
portal_ancient_pillars_effect: %0 large pillars arranged in a perfect circle; it kind of reminds you of Stonehenge. Each one has a different symbol on it.
portal_ancient_pillars_effect2: %0 large pillars arranged in a perfect circle. Each one has a different symbol on it. %1 of the pillars glow with a soft blue light that seems to come from nowhere.
portal_gate_desc: A massive wall on the far side of the ruined city seems to run across the landscape. A grand gate is present near the ancient ruins. All aircraft sent over the wall stop transmitting immediately and have failed to return.
portal_gate_mission_result: The gate uses a complex locking mechanism which appears impossible to bypass. Fortunately for you, the Codex Infernium outlines a process to build a "key" to open the gate.
portal_lake_desc: Beyond the wall a large "lake" exists. The lake appears to be filled not with water but with blood. The blood is boiling and tiny bubbles pop across the surface. A steady heat radiates from the surface of the lake. An island can be seen in the distance with a great tower on it.
portal_lake_mission_effect: An unusual large lake exists here; scout the area to establish a base of operations.
portal_lake_mission_result: Samples of the lake water have been retrieved for analysis. A spot has been picked to construct a harbor, but the unusual properties of the "water" require more study before anything can be constructed.
portal_cooling_tower_effect: Reduces the power needed to keep your Harbors cool by %0%.
portal_transport_unlocked: Spire Supplies have been unlocked. Go to Resources Tab -> Spire Supply Tab to manage your Supply Cargo.
portal_spire_desc: An island containing an enormous tower exists at the center of the lake. It is so tall you can't see where it ends. Your view of the spire fades into the hazy sky; you feel as if an ominous presence gazes down on you.
portal_spire_mission_effect: Send a team ashore to scout the island with the mysterious spire.
portal_spire_mission_result: You sent an expedition ashore to scout the island, but a deadly miasma covers the island and everyone who went ashore died.
portal_spire_mission_flair: The air here smells foul... it's probably nothing.
portal_spire_bridge_collapse: A bridge crossing a lava river that leads to the spire appears to have collapsed. You'll have to reconstruct it.
portal_sphinx_desc: A creature guards the spire that you've taken to calling the "Sphinx".
portal_sphinx_effect: It won't let you pass; try to learn how to get past the "Sphinx".
portal_sphinx_effect3: The Sphinx no longer blocks your way.
portal_sphinx_msg: The "Sphinx" has asked you to prove you are worthy by answering a series of complicated mathematical equations. You've also noticed it seems to have a fondness for eating soul gems and likes shiny things; maybe you could bribe it?
portal_sphinx_answer_msg: The Sphinx moves out of the way, allowing you access to the tower.
portal_sphinx_bribe_msg: The Sphinx has given you a book, but it refuses to move out of the doorway.
portal_sphinx_warlord_effect: It just looks at you with disappointment.
portal_spire_survey_effect: Survey the inside of the Tower.
portal_spire_survey_msg: A holographic device found in the lobby of the spire indicates that each level of the tower is like a micro world with a unique biome filled with dangerous monsters and that in order to climb the spire you must defeat a floor guardian on each level. You devise a plan to construct combat mechs to ascend the tower.
portal_mechbay_effect: Houses Mechs to assault the Spire
portal_mechbay_unlocked: The Mech Lab has been unlocked. Go to Civics Tab -> Mech Lab Tab to manage your mechs.
portal_demon_artificer_effect: Houses Demons to assault the Spire
portal_waygate_effect: Construct a portal to reach an Elder Demon Lord. This requires blood sacrifices.
portal_waygate_open: Divert your mech forces to battle the Demon Lord.
portal_edenic_gate_effect: Modify the Waygate to reach a different realm.
portal_edenic_gate_effect_complete: The Waygate has connected to a higher plane.
portal_spire_type_sand_desc: The majority of the terrain is sandy.
portal_spire_type_swamp_desc: Swamp land covers most of the terrain.
portal_spire_type_forest_desc: Trees grow everywhere across the landscape.
portal_spire_type_jungle_desc: Thick jungle-like plant life grows everywhere.
portal_spire_type_rocky_desc: Rocky terrain covers the entire landscape.
portal_spire_type_gravel_desc: A gravel-like surface covers the terrain.
portal_spire_type_muddy_desc: The whole landscape is covered in mud that's up to a meter deep in places.
portal_spire_type_grass_desc: A nice grassy surface covers the land.
portal_spire_type_concrete_desc: The entire landscape is just a flat, open area paved in concrete.
portal_spire_status_freeze_desc: The air temperature is freezing cold.
portal_spire_status_hot_desc: The air temperature is smoldering hot.
portal_spire_status_hilly_desc: The terrain is not very flat.
portal_spire_status_radioactive_desc: A high Geiger count can be read anywhere in this land.
portal_spire_status_dust_desc: Thick dust coats everything here and gets into everything.
portal_spire_status_river_desc: A river is present here, and must be crossed.
portal_spire_status_tar_desc: Tar pits are scattered around presenting a hazard.
portal_spire_status_steam_desc: Steam jets blast out of fissures across the land.
portal_spire_status_flooded_desc: The whole land is flooded under several inches of water.
portal_spire_status_rain_desc: The rain here never seems to stop.
portal_spire_status_hail_desc: Hail constantly falls from the sky.
portal_spire_status_chasm_desc: A chasm run through the land that must be crossed.
portal_spire_status_dark_desc: No natural light seems to exist here.
portal_spire_conquest: The %0 has been defeated; you have cleared floor %1.
portal_spire_conquest_stone: You have found a %0 Blood Stone.
portal_mech_chassis_wheel_desc: A mech that uses traditional wheels for locomotion.
portal_mech_chassis_tread_desc: A mech that uses treads for locomotion.
portal_mech_chassis_biped_desc: A bipedal mech designed to walk upright.
portal_mech_chassis_spider_desc: A spider-mech design using eight legs.
portal_mech_chassis_hover_desc: A mech which glides over the terrain by hovering.
portal_mech_chassis_imp_desc: Imp are basic demons, not very strong but can be armed with anything.
portal_mech_chassis_flying_imp_desc: Winged Imps are able to fly for short distances.
portal_mech_chassis_hound_desc: Hellhounds are fast, have sharp teeth, and usualy radiate some primal element.
portal_mech_chassis_harpy_desc: Harpies are fast and moble, but fairly weak.
portal_mech_chassis_barghest_desc: Barghests are vicious but not very strong.
portal_mech_chassis_cambion_desc: Cambions are demonic hybrids. They can use any kind of standard weaponry.
portal_mech_chassis_minotaur_desc: Minotaurs are bull-like demons. They are strong and brutal.
portal_mech_chassis_nightmare_desc: Nightmares are demonic horse-like creatures. They radiate primal elemental energy.
portal_mech_chassis_rakshasa_desc: Rakshasa are ferocious creatures that come in a wide variety of types.
portal_mech_chassis_golem_desc: Golems are normally inanimate materials that have been brought to life using metaphysics.
portal_mech_chassis_dragon_desc: Draconic fiends are very powerful and have an elemental breath attack in addition to giant claws.
portal_mech_chassis_snake_desc: Giant Snake demons are not to be trifled with.
portal_mech_chassis_gorgon_desc: Gorgons are large monsters that can have many different unnatural properties.
portal_mech_chassis_hydra_desc: Hydrae are large multiheaded monsters. Each head can have a different breath attack.
portal_mech_size_small_desc: Scout-class mech with limited firepower. Not very powerful, but they help larger mechs navigate terrain.
portal_mech_size_medium_desc: Standard-sized mechs are often the most versatile, being adaptable to any role.
portal_mech_size_large_desc: Heavy mechs are often deployed to counter serious threats; they are costly and slow-moving but powerful.
portal_mech_size_titan_desc: Titan-class mechs are gigantic; although often considered impractical, their massive size allows them to dominate the field.
portal_mech_size_collector_desc: Collector mechs search for usable resources. They do not aid in combat.
portal_mech_size_minion_desc: Minions are small demons that are mostly used as scouts. They are not very powerful but can help support larger demons.
portal_mech_size_fiend_desc: Fiends are the standard rank and file of the demonic forces. They are adaptable for a wide variety of purposes.
portal_mech_size_cyberdemon_desc: Cyberdemons are cybernetic monstrosities created from fusing fiends with technology. They can come with a wide variety of armaments.
portal_mech_size_archfiend_desc: Archfiends are large powerful demonic creatures that dominate the fields of battle.
portal_mech_weapon_laser_desc: Laser weapons fire intense bursts of light to burn targets at long distances.
portal_mech_weapon_flame_desc: Flamethrowers fire jets of ignited flammable liquids at targets. They are most effective at close range.
portal_mech_weapon_plasma_desc: A plasma cutter slices into enemy targets using highly charged particles at medium distances.
portal_mech_weapon_kinetic_desc: Machine guns are traditional kinetic weapons that fire a high volume of metal slugs at a target.
portal_mech_weapon_missile_desc: Missiles can track targets at long distances and blast large areas.
portal_mech_weapon_sonic_desc: Sonic weaponry creates intense vibrations to shake a target apart.
portal_mech_weapon_shotgun_desc: Shotguns fire a spread of projectiles at a target; they are devastating at close range.
portal_mech_weapon_tesla_desc: The Tesla cannon discharges high voltage at a target; it's basically a lightning gun.
portal_mech_weapon_claws_desc: Razor-sharp claws that can rip things to shreds.
portal_mech_weapon_axe_desc: A giant axe that can cleave enemies in half.
portal_mech_weapon_hammer_desc: A large war hammer can smash enemies to pieces.
portal_mech_weapon_venom_desc: Venomous Fangs can take down many things that are otherwise tough to kill.
portal_mech_weapon_cold_desc: A chilling breath attack that can rapidly freeze things.
portal_mech_weapon_fire_desc: Can breath fire in a cone igniting anything unfortunate enough to get caught.
portal_mech_weapon_shock_desc: Can spew bolts of lightning at an enemy.
portal_mech_weapon_acid_desc: Can spray a target with acid effectively melting them to death.
portal_mech_weapon_stone_desc: Rock Golems hit hard and are very sturdy.
portal_mech_weapon_iron_desc: Iron Golems are nearly impervious to damage and can smash most basic foes with ease.
portal_mech_weapon_flesh_desc: Flesh Golems are made from carcasses. They are typicaly putrid constructs that spread toxic diseases everywhere.
portal_mech_weapon_ice_desc: Ice Golems are constructs made of solid ice. They grip enemies and freeze them to death.
portal_mech_weapon_magma_desc: Magma Golems are made of molten rock. They are a bit softer than most golems but burn everything they touch.
portal_mech_equip_shields_desc: Energy shields can protect a mech from a variety of threats.
portal_mech_equip_sonar_desc: Sonar can allow a mech to navigate unimpeded in environments that limit normal vision.
portal_mech_equip_grapple_desc: A grappling hook can be used to help a robot transverse otherwise impassable terrain obstacles.
portal_mech_equip_infrared_desc: Infrared sensors aid mechs operating in low-light environments.
portal_mech_equip_flare_desc: Flares can be used for a variety of purposes, from illuminating dark areas to signalling allies.
portal_mech_equip_radiator_desc: A radiator to generate heat can stop a mech from freezing up in cold-weather environments.
portal_mech_equip_coolant_desc: Extra coolant can prevent a mech from overheating in hot environments.
portal_mech_equip_stabilizer_desc: The stabilizer will help prevent unstable ground from slowing down a mech.
portal_mech_equip_seals_desc: Rubber seals can help keep sensitive equipment clean and operating efficiently.
portal_mech_equip_jumpjet_desc: Jump Jets are thrusters that help a mech "jump", increasing its mobility.
portal_mech_equip_battery_desc: An extra battery pack improves the mech's reserve power.
portal_mech_equip_target_desc: A targeting computer increases weapon effectiveness when using suboptimal weapons against a target.
portal_mech_equip_scavenger_desc: Special training allows the minion to recover small amounts of supplies.
portal_mech_equip_scouter_desc: Extra scout training improves the scouting aspect of the minion.
portal_mech_equip_darkvision_desc: Darkvision allows the demon to see well in near darkness.
portal_mech_equip_echo_desc: The demon has a special echolocation organ that helps them navigate.
portal_mech_equip_thermal_desc: Heat vision allows the demon to track enemies in cloudy conditions.
portal_mech_equip_manashield_desc: The demon can generate an ethereal shield that repulses hazards.
portal_mech_equip_cold_desc: This demon is extra resistant to cold.
portal_mech_equip_heat_desc: This demon is extra resistant to heat.
portal_mech_equip_athletic_desc: More athletic than average, helps them counter some hazards.
portal_mech_equip_lucky_desc: Somehow they are just less affected by bad things.
portal_mech_equip_stoneskin_desc: Their skin is harder than normal, helping negate some bad things.
portal_mech_scrap_refund: Scrap for %0 Supply and %1 Soul Gems
portal_oven_desc2: The recipe is incomplete, where could the rest be hidden?
portal_oven_effect1: Construct a part of the Cooker
portal_dish_soul_steeper_desc: Consumes the souls of powerful foes to aid the creation of the Devilish Dish.
portal_dish_soul_steeper_effect1: Dish speed +5% per spire floor cleared.
portal_dish_soul_steeper_flair: Who knew boiling infernal souls could have such flavor?
portal_dish_life_infuser_desc: Infuse the dish with the lifeforce of your own.
portal_devilish_dish_flavor0: It has not begun yet, what are you waiting for?
portal_wasteland_desc: The wasteland is a vast sub region of the badlands that is home to your demonic army. It serves as your primary base of operations.
portal_throne_of_evil_capture2: Click to sacrifice %0 and consume their heart.
portal_throne_of_evil_skill1: Click to enter skill point assignment mode.
portal_throne_of_evil_skill2: Click to exit skill point assignment mode.
portal_incinerator_desc: Burn things for power: plants, debris, bodies, anything.
portal_tunneler_effect2: Enables Dig Demons to find rare resources.
portal_twisted_lab_flair: The horrors contained within are indescribable
portal_corpse_pile_desc: Gather bodies for shipping to the incinerator.
portal_codex_effect: Fuse resources into the Codex Infernium
portal_tavern_flair: Just don't ask what's in the brew.
portal_invasion_msg: You have encountered a new enemy of %0.
portal_wonder_skulls_flair: Don't listen to anything it says
eden_purify_well_msg: You've discovered a well of pure water on floor %0. It radiates holy energy.
eden_asphodel_hostile: Hostile creatures have started to harass your operations in the asphodel meadows.
eden_asphodel_desc: Open fields stretch as far as can be seen. Ghostly flowers seem to grow here and a strange sense of demotivating mediocracy permeates this place.
eden_asphodel_desc_peaceful: Translucent wispy looking bipedal creatures roam about who seem to largely ignore you.
eden_asphodel_desc_hostile: The ghostly denizens barely react to you, but hostile creatures cloaked in shadows attack you on sight.
eden_survery_meadows_action: This place fills you with a feeling that you are being watched and don't belong here. Large numbers of unremarkable souls seem to roam this place aimlessly; you have also picked samples of the ghost flower for analysis.
eden_rune_gate_effect: Construct a portal to the unknown divine.
eden_elysium_desc: Idyllic plains seem to extend forever in all directions. An aura of contentment radiates from this place.
eden_survey_fields_msg: You attempt to scout the fields but are immediately repelled by formidable angelic agents. The area is quite well fortified against intrusion containing a fortress and many angelic patrols.
eden_siege_fortress_effect: Attempt to lay waste to the fortress.
eden_siege_fortress_success: You successfully inflicted %0% damage to the fortress.
eden_raid_supplies_effect: Attempt to disrupt the fortress supply lines.
eden_raid_fortress_success: You successfully disrupted fortress readiness by %0%.
eden_ambush_patrol_effect: Attempt to ambush an enemy patrol.
eden_ambush_patrol_success: You have successfully wiped out an enemy patrol.
eden_ambush_patrol_fail: Your attempt to wipe out an enemy patrol ended in defeat.
eden_scout_elysium_effect: Send scouts deep into the Elysium Fields to find out what is out there.
eden_scout_elysium_result: The area directly around the fallen fortress has been pacified, but you discover a giant clear lake some distance away and as you get closer to it enemy resistance increases dramatically. Half your expedition force was lost while scouting.
eden_isle_desc: A massive paradisian island surrounded by pure crystal clear water.
eden_rushmore_flair: They captured your good side perfectly.
eden_reincarnation_flair: Recycled souls are just as good as new ones.
eden_spirit_vacuum_flair: She's gone from suck to blow!
eden_soul_compactor_flair: I don’t always mug god. But when I do, I do it for pocket change.
eden_palace_desc: The Palace of Eternity is a spectacular structure on the Isle of the Blessed that radiates such intense divine energy that you can't even approach it.
eden_palace_sup: The Palace of Eternity is a structure on the Isle of the Blessed that seems to be the focal point of the heavens.
eden_scout_palace_result: The angelic creatures that previously guarded this place seem to be gone. A majestic looking dead creature sits on the throne. You're not sure how it died but you are probably responsible. The corpse radiates intense divine energy.
eden_tomb_constuct: Construct the Tomb of the Dead God
eden_tomb_effect: Contains the body of an unknown deity
eden_tomb_flair: Just roll a boulder in front of it.
eden_conduit_effect: Create a conduit between the tomb and the throne to drain the energy
eden_conduit_flair: Ok, it's a high tech extension cord.
eden_infuser_effect: Infuse whoever sits on the throne with divine powers
fortress_threat: %0 criaturas demoníacas han sido vistas en las proximidades
fortress_threat_high: Los topógrafos no vivirán mucho con esta gran actividad
fortress_threat_medium: Aunque son peligrosos, los topógrafos deberían poder operar sin demasiadas víctimas
fortress_threat_low: Los agrimensores rara vez deben ser asesinados con el nivel actual de actividad
fortress_stationed: Número de soldados estacionados en la fortaleza
fortress_sieged: Tu fortaleza fue asediada por criaturas demoníacas. El ataque fue repelido. %0 demonios fueron asesinados pero las paredes perdieron %1% integridad
fortress_lost: Tu fortaleza fue invadida por criaturas demoníacas. Todos los soldados y agrimensores que trabajaban allí fueron asesinados
fortress_patrol_desc: %0 patrullas vagando por el páramo demoníaco.
fortress_patrol_killed: Una patrulla fue eliminada, todos los soldados %0 fueron asesinados
fortress_patrol_casualties_revive: Sus patrullas sufrieron %0 bajas pero %1 soldados revivieron.
fortress_killed: Un agrimensor fue asesinado por criaturas demoníacas
fortress_eviscerated: %0 topógrafos fueron eviscerados por criaturas demoníacas
fortress_enemy_defeat: The %0 fortress has fallen! You have captured their commander.
hell_observation_tooltip: Go to the hell observations panel. All activity that occurs each day in the Hell Dimension is logged and compiled here.
hell_report_log_tooltip: A report log is made at the end of each game day and logs all the events that happened in hell in chronological order. For storage/loading reasons they are not saved on refresh, and at most the past %0 logs will be kept.
hell_report_log_start: There are an estimated %0 demons around the Fortress.
hell_report_log_encounter: %0 found and killed %1 demons around the Fortress.
hell_report_log_encounter_fail: %0 failed to find any demons today.
hell_report_log_patrol_ambush: %0 got ambushed by demons and killed %1 of them.
hell_report_log_patrol_casualties: %0 soldiers were wounded and %1 were killed.
hell_report_log_soul_find: %1 %0 was found from killing the demons.
hell_report_log_soul_search: %1 %0 was found on a dead demon.
hell_report_log_patrols_lost: %0 patrol(s) got disbanded due to lack of available soldiers.
hell_report_log_siege: The fortress was attacked and destroyed in a siege by demons, causing surveyor losses of %0 and soldier losses of %1. %2 demons were killed in retaliation.
hell_report_log_siege_fail: Demons attempted a failed siege on the fortress, damaging the walls by %0%. %1 demons were killed in retaliation.
hell_report_log_demons: %0 new demons were spotted around the fortress.
hell_report_log_surveyors: 1 surveyor was killed by roaming demons.
hell_report_log_surveyors_plural: %0 surveyors were killed by roaming demons.
hell_report_log_soul_attractors: Soul Attractors drew %0 souls into the Soul Forge.
hell_report_log_ghost_trappers: Ghost Trappers exported %0 souls into the Soul Forge.
hell_report_log_soul_forge: Soul Forge guards killed %0 demons around The Pit.
hell_report_log_soul_craft: The Soul Forge accumulated enough souls and created a %0.
hell_graph_error_data_missing: Error: No data has been chosen.
outer_syndicate: A growing criminal organization known as the %0 has begun raiding your ships. They can no longer be ignored; you must begin militarizing space to protect against pirates.
outer_shipyard_park: Ships parked at %0 are out of service and require no crew or fuel.
outer_shipyard_dispatch_damaged: Hull too damaged to launch. Repairs must bring it to %0% before it can be dispatched.
outer_shipyard_class_corvette_desc: Corvette-class ships are the smallest and cheapest. They are usually used as scouts.
outer_shipyard_class_frigate_desc: Frigate-class ships are still small, fast, and maneuverable, but are larger and more heavily armed than Corvettes. They are usually used as quick assault ships.
outer_shipyard_class_destroyer_desc: Destroyers are medium-sized ships that pack serious firepower. They are often used as enforcers, bringing a balance between firepower, cost, and speed.
outer_shipyard_class_cruiser_desc: Cruisers are large ships that are typically stationed in a sector as a deterrent against attack. They are often used as command ships.
outer_shipyard_class_battlecruiser_desc: Battlecruisers are super-heavy cruisers that serve the purpose of crushing enemy forces with overwhelming force. They are typically deployed as flagships for entire fleets.
outer_shipyard_class_dreadnought_desc: Dreadnoughts are enormous ships that are typically considered impractical. They often have enough firepower and armor to wipe out entire fleets of enemy ships.
outer_shipyard_class_explorer_desc: The Explorer class ship is a special craft designed to house the EmDrive. This ship is specially designed to cross the interstellar void.
outer_shipyard_engine_ion_desc: The Ion Engine is a basic propulsion technology that is cheap and efficient at moving spaceships.
outer_shipyard_engine_tie_desc: The Twin Ion Engine is a dual-mounted version of the basic Ion Engine. Twice the drives, twice the thrust.
outer_shipyard_engine_pulse_desc: The Pulse Drive creates a rapid series of tiny explosions to accelerate.
outer_shipyard_engine_photon_desc: The Photon Drive is an advanced ship drive that generates a stream of photons to propel the craft.
outer_shipyard_engine_vacuum_desc: The Vacuum Drive uses advanced physics to manipulate space to move the ship.
outer_shipyard_engine_emdrive_desc: The EmDrive is an advanced engine that can reach near light speed, it requires a specially designed ship.
outer_shipyard_engine_optimizations_desc: Engine Optimizations improve the efficiency and performance of your ship's engines, reducing power consumption as well as increasing speed.
outer_shipyard_engine_electrokinetic_des: The Nano Electrokinetic Thruster uses electro-osmosis to achieve a high thrust to power ratio enabling faster ships.
outer_shipyard_weapon_railgun_desc: Railguns are an effective weapon that uses minimal power.
outer_shipyard_weapon_laser_desc: Laser weapons fire a continuous stream of light at a target; they use a lot of energy but are highly accurate.
outer_shipyard_weapon_p_laser_desc: Pulse Lasers fire intense bursts of energy; they are like the machine gun version of a laser.
outer_shipyard_weapon_plasma_desc: Plasma Beams are less effective over long ranges than lasers, but they are more destructive.
outer_shipyard_weapon_phaser_desc: The Phaser is a pulsed directional energy weapon; it uses a lot of energy but is highly destructive.
outer_shipyard_weapon_disruptor_desc: Disruptors fire intense cosmic rays at a target, causing damage at the molecular level.
outer_shipyard_power_solar_desc: Solar Arrays require no fuel upkeep, but they don't generate a lot of power.
outer_shipyard_power_diesel_desc: Diesel Generators run on Oil and are reliable, but they don't have a high output and are not suitable for large ships.
outer_shipyard_power_fission_desc: Fission power plants generate a lot of power, but consume Uranium.
outer_shipyard_power_fusion_desc: Fusion generators are clean and efficient, but consume large amounts of Helium-3.
outer_shipyard_power_elerium_desc: Elerium generators have unmatched output, but require use of Elerium as a fuel.
outer_shipyard_power_antimatter_desc: Antimatter generators have superior output, but require use of Positronium as a fuel.
outer_shipyard_sensor_visual_desc: Ship will rely on visual sightings only to find targets.
outer_shipyard_sensor_radar_desc: Radar systems are used to find enemy ships.
outer_shipyard_sensor_lidar_desc: Long-range Lidar systems are used to locate enemy ships.
outer_shipyard_sensor_quantum_desc: An advanced Quantum Scanner is used to find enemy targets.
tau_scan: Your ship, the %0, has arrived in Tau Ceti and has begun surveying the system. The system contains 4 inner rocky planets and 4 outer gas giants.
tau_star: The star %0. It is a G Type star with about 78% of the total mass of the %1.
tau_star_goe_facility_effect: Cloning facility constructed on the Ringworld which will create more of your species from stored DNA samples and allow you to populate the Tau Ceti system.
tau_home: New %0 is the 3rd-closest planet to the star Tau Ceti, it is at the inner edge of the habitable zone at 0.5 AU.
tau_new_mission_effect: Survey the planet New %0 for resources and colony sites.
tau_home_mission_result: Several sites of interest have been mapped on the surface of New %0. Locations for mining efforts, a prime location for a colony, and what appears to be a long-abandoned alien outpost have been marked for exploitation.
tau_home_dismantle_effect: Dismantle the %0 and use its resources to establish a colony.
tau_home_excavate_msg: Now that the outpost has been fully excavated, it can be researched to learn its functions.
tau_home_tau_factory_effect: Manufacture new materials from old materials. Each Factory has %0 production lines.
tau_jump_gate_effect: Jump Gates allow travel at 100 times the speed of light between two connected gates. For nearby star systems this effectively connects them, allowing them to share resources. Requires two paired gates to be of any use.
tau_jump_gate_effect2: Jump Gates allow FTL travel between two connected gates. This gate connects to %0.
tau_jump_gate_disabled: Jump Gates allow travel between two connected gates, however this gate is currently disabled. It will need to be repaired before it can be used.
tau_red: New %0 is the 4th-closest planet to the star Tau Ceti. It is on the outer edge of the habitable zone, at 1.24 AU.
tau_red_mission_result: A site for a colony has been found on the surface of New %0. The climate here isn't idyllic for your species, but it is perfectly habitable.
tau_red_orbital_platform_msg: While constructing your first orbital platform around %0 you observed a less advanced species of weasel-like creatures who seem to inhabit this planet. Perhaps the alien research facility on %1 has records on them.
tau_red_contact_effect: Contact the Womlings on your own.
tau_red_introduce_effect: Have Jeff introduce you to the Womlings.
tau_red_subjugate_effect: Prepare a show of force to intimidate the Womlings into submission.
tau_red_womling_mine_effect_a: Employs Womlings to mine precious %0 for you.
tau_red_womling_mine_effect_b: Employs Womlings to mine %0, %1, & %2 for you.
tau_red_womling_mine_effect_c: Employs Womlings to mine %0, %1, %2, %3, %4, %5, %6, & %7 for you.
tau_red_womling_mine_flair: No need to burn down any trees
tau_red_womling_advancement: The Womlings have advanced to tech level %0.
tau_gas_desc: A gas giant located 5.6 AU from the local star. It is a great source for fuel.
tau_gas_contest_effect: Ask your people for name suggestions for the Gas Giant. You'll then pick a winner from the top voted entries.
tau_gas_contest_effect_alt: Ask the Womlings for name suggestions for the Gas Giant. You'll then pick a winner from the top voted entries.
tau_gas_contest_reject: Reject all the names because they are terrible; keep calling it %0.
tau_gas2_desc: A gas giant located 8.2 AU from the local star. It is a lot smaller than %0 but it still the 2nd largest planet in the system.
tau_gas2_contest_effect: Run another contest to name the outermost planet of the Tau Ceti system.
tau_gas2_contest_flair: Surely you'll get better names this time... right?
tau_gas2_contest_reject: Never again; call it %0 out of spite.
tau_gas2_alien_station_repair_effect: You've detected a powered-down space station in orbit around %0. You should send a survey team to it.
tau_gas2_alien_station_msg: You've surveyed the abandoned space station around %0. You'll have to make major repairs to get it operational again.
tau_gas2_alien_station_data1: You've discovered extensive genetic information about the %0 in the alien data.
tau_gas2_alien_station_data2: You've discovered a recipe for %0 in the alien data.
tau_gas2_alien_station_data3: You've discovered advancements in the alien data that can be exploited by your civilization.
tau_gas2_alien_station_data4: You've discovered a new type of %0 in the alien data.
tau_gas2_alien_station_data5: You've deciphered additional technological advancements in the alien data.
tau_gas2_alien_station_data6: You've discovered research in the alien data for how to construct a Matrioshka Brain around an artificial sun.
tau_gas2_alien_station_data6_alt: You've discovered research in the alien data for how to construct a Ringworld powered by the sun.
tau_gas2_ignite_gas_giant_effect: Ignite the gas giant to power on the %0.
tau_gas2_ignite_gas_giant_effect3: Retire and let the super computer run the colony.
tau_roid_desc: A debris disc encompasses the outer area of the local star system, ranging from 10 AU to 55 AU. Mining prospects make it an attractive area for development.
tau_roid_mission_effect: Launch a series of probes to scout the %0.
tau_roid_mission_result: Many mineral rich sites have been detected, but several of your probes were destroyed by aggressive space creatures.
tau_roid_patrol_ship_effect: Each patrol ship will help protect your asteroid belt interests. You can have more interests than you can safely guard, but they will suffer penalties if you don't have enough ships to patrol all your sectors.
tau_plague: News has reached you that the %0 has quarantined one of their cities due to an outbreak of a new disease.
tau_plague2: Reports of the %0 plague are starting to appear all over the homeworld. Quarantine measures have been enacted to contain it while a cure is researched.
tau_plague3: Cases of the %0 plague are being reported all over the %1 system.
tau_plague4: A growing faction thinks you should shut down the Jump Gate to preserve the %0 colony.
tau_plague5b: All transmissions from the %0 system have stopped. The last messages received indicate widespread chaos and disorder.
scout_sun_gate: Visible infrastructure from the gate region shows heavy damage and no signs of life. A single derelict ship has been detected adrift nearby.
scout_spc_red: The colony on %0 shows signs of heavy damage, no life signs are being detected but movement was observed on the surface.
scout_spc_home: %0 is completely overrun by billions of undead creatures. No signs of survivors have been detected. Trying to land a ship would be suicidal.
scout_spc_home_moonless: Despite the catastrophic damage caused by the moon collision with %0, there are billions of undead creatures observed roaming on the surface. Landing a ship would be suicidal.
scout_spc_moon: Your facilities on the moon have all been abandoned and wrecked, but you see no obvious signs of danger.
scout_spc_hell: You discover an automated distress beacon on %0 that was transmitting with low power. The signal was weak but it was enough to locate the source, a crashed ship on the surface.
scout_spc_found_ship: An abandoned ship found near %0 has been salvaged and towed back to your shipyard.
